Name: Kraft Heinz Co
Description: The Kraft Heinz Company (KHC) is a leading American food and beverage conglomerate, formed through the strategic merger of Kraft Foods and Heinz. Headquartered in both Chicago, Illinois, and Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, the company boasts a diverse portfolio of iconic brands, including Kraft, Heinz, Oscar Mayer, and Philadelphia, among others. With a strong focus on innovation and sustainability, Kraft Heinz is committed to delivering high-quality products while advancing efficiency across its global supply chain. The company is well-positioned to leverage trends in consumer preferences, aiming to drive growth in a competitive food industry landscape.
Address: ONE PPG PLACE, PITTSBURGH, PA, UNITED STATES, 15222
